adventure.title: Starter Sprint
adventure.description: A 30-puzzle Adventure Mode MVP sprint with a short chill tutorial opening.

en.adventure.starter_sprint.puzzle.starter_: Pipette, the rainbow has gone lumpy. Put each color with its own family.
Good, Pipette. A small rainbow, but neatly folded.
Pipette, this glass is proud and sparkly. Finish it well and it will applaud itself.
A glittering result. The prismatic beaker is being very modest about it.
Now, Pipette, aim the right color into the tinted glass. It has opinions.
Excellent. The opinionated beaker has been satisfied.
